import html # Predefined HTML structure for a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_blog_entry(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a blog entry for safe web display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. content : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str An HTML string with the sanitized headline and body, ready for inclusion in a web page. Notes ----- * Uses `html.escape` to neutralize any potentially malicious HTML or JavaScript. * Preserves line breaks by converting newline characters to `
` tags. """ # Escape HTML special characters in headline and content safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Convert line breaks to
tags for the body safe_content = safe_content.replace('\n', '
\n') # Populate the predefined format formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_content) return formatted_post
